title: CoinGecko Crypto Scraper
description: Fetch structured cryptocurrency market data from the official CoinGecko API by coin ID, search query, or market-cap rank. Keyless access is limited to tiny evaluations; use your own appropriately licensed API key for larger or commercial workflows.

coinIds.title: Coin IDs
coinIds.description: Official CoinGecko coin IDs such as bitcoin, ethereum, or solana. Coin names and ticker symbols belong in Search Queries.

searchQueries.title: Search Queries
searchQueries.description: Coin names or symbols to resolve through CoinGecko search. At most 10 queries per run.

maxSearchResults.title: Max Results per Search
maxSearchResults.description: Maximum CoinGecko matches selected from each search query.

topCoins.title: Top Coins by Market Cap
topCoins.description: Number of top market-cap coins to fetch. Set 0 to use only coin IDs and searches.

vsCurrency.title: Quote Currency
vsCurrency.description: CoinGecko quote-currency code such as usd, eur, inr, btc, or sats. The Actor validates it against CoinGecko before fetching market rows.

apiAccess.title: CoinGecko API Access
apiAccess.description: Keyless is for tiny evaluation runs. Demo requires a free Demo key. Pro uses the paid API host and is the appropriate mode for a CoinGecko plan that permits your production/commercial use.

apiKey.title: CoinGecko API Key
apiKey.description: Required for Demo or Pro access. The key is sent only in CoinGecko's documented request header and is never written to output or logs.

proxyConfiguration.title: Legacy Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Keep disabled. Proxy rotation is not supported because it must not be used to bypass CoinGecko rate limits.
